## Checklist

- [ ] `plugins/<slug>.md` added, from `templates/plugin-entry.md`
- [ ] Entry added to `plugins/index.json` (matches `plugins/index.schema.json`)
- [ ] Row added to `plugins/README.md` **and** the root `README.md`, alphabetically
- [ ] The repository is public, has a LICENSE, and has a tagged release
- [ ] `PluginIntro.Version` matches the tag
- [ ] The plugin runs against a real Infra + Fractal
- [ ] No credentials in action forms, logs, or committed output
